objective: Obtain an honest same-task development comparison on one short multi-step Retail task. First prove mixed exact-checkpoint rollouts, then run a two-step terminal-only GRPO update, then compare the frozen SFT and GRPO checkpoints under identical held-out sampling seeds.

source_binding.working_tree_policy: Do not mutate the four bound runtime files between prescreen, training, and paired evaluation. Every remote copy and run manifest must record the hashes below.

task_selection.target_mutation: Replace the pending-order Desk Lamp with the cheapest available variant and refund the price difference to the bound gift card.
task_selection.terminal_reward: Programmatic final database-state match gated by user_stop; no LLM Judge, action matching, communication score, or Guard score is used as training reward.
task_selection.selection_rationale: Task 44 is an rl_train task with a single deterministic write, a short nominal path, owner-reviewed corrected SFT trajectories, and an auditable final database state. It is intentionally a same-task behavior-shaping experiment, not a generalization test.
task_selection.known_risk: The SFT checkpoint may already be at ceiling. Historical tau2 total reward also mis-scored a correct trajectory because of a static calculate-action expression, so only the DB environment component is authorized for terminal training reward. Full tau2 and policy checks remain separate evaluation signals.

phases.entry_condition: Bound files and model hashes match.
phases.pass_condition: Exactly 4/4 transport-complete, no truncation, terminal DB success count is 1 through 3, reward std is non-zero, and at least one terminal-positive trajectory has explicit confirmation before the single target write with no unrelated write or tool error.
phases.stop_condition: All four rewards equal, any transport/truncation failure, or all terminal-positive trajectories rely on a hard policy violation.

phases.pass_condition: At least one mixed-reward group, finite non-zero gradient norm on an optimizer step, finite KL diagnostics, changed trainable parameters, complete raw evidence, and a merged checkpoint hash.
phases.stop_condition: No usable mixed group, non-finite optimization signal, no parameter change, OOM, or incomplete rollout evidence.

phases.frozen_fields: Task, opening, user seed, agent sampling seeds, temperature 0.8, top_p 1.0, top_k 0, completion limit 4096, rollout limits, user model, policy, tools, upstream commit, and evaluator must be identical. Only checkpoint path and checkpoint hash may differ.
phases.primary_metric: Terminal DB successes out of 8 valid rollouts.
secondary_metrics: Full tau2 task successes out of 8
Tool-call count conditioned separately on terminal success and failure
phases.development_positive_rule: GRPO terminal DB successes exceed SFT by at least 1/8, transport completeness is not worse, full tau2 success is not worse, and hard policy violations do not increase.
phases.interpretation_if_passed: Small same-task development improvement under two frozen seed groups; not statistical, business, policy-compliance, or generalization evidence.
phases.anti_cherry_pick: Do not replace seeds after seeing results. An exact-seed retry is allowed only for a recorded infrastructure failure that produced no valid rollout; preserve both attempts.
